subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact no-read, no-write, and no-persist guarantees and exclusions must a private session enforce across workspace context, transcripts, memory, tools, media, logs, providers, and channels?
rationale: A visible privacy toggle would create a security promise, but current discussion does not settle the threat model, activation authority, unavoidable external exposure, or every persistence boundary.

options.title: Full Private Session
options.body: Design a per-session mode that blocks private workspace reads and durable content persistence while clearly documenting unavoidable provider and transport exposure.

options.title: Demo Context Mode
options.body: Offer only context suppression under a narrower name without claiming ephemeral storage or strong privacy guarantees.

options.title: Defer Core Support
options.body: Decline a first-class guarantee and document isolated workspaces or separate Gateway instances as the supported privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Full Private Session
recommendation.body: Design a per-session mode that blocks private workspace reads and durable content persistence while clearly documenting unavoidable provider and transport exposure.
